title: Fruiting (picked by hand)
note: A COMPONENT schema, added to an individual asset (the asset popup's Add schema button) and stored as its own top-level 'fruiting' block. It makes a bush (or any plant the game scatters or places) bear fruit that is picked by hand ONE AT A TIME: right-click with one of the 'tools' in the active slot and one fruit comes off, giving one of each listed drop; the missing fruit all returns regrow_days after the latest pick. Used by the berry bushes (bush_blueberry and so on). Runtime: Assets/Scripts/World/BerryBushes.cs. Trees keep their own fruit rules in the growth group (growth.rules.fruit).

tools.label: Pick With (any one works; none = by hand)
tools.note: The tools that can pick it: tool assets and/or tags (any member tool works). Empty = by hand.

drops.label: Gives (one of each per fruit)
drops.note: The assets one picked fruit gives: one of each listed item goes to the toolbar.

regrow_days.label: Regrow (days)
regrow_days.note: Game days after the LATEST pick before all the picked fruit is back.
